name: Oxford Comma Go Away
author: williampatton

sections.description: When activated this plugin will filter your post or page content and strip out any Oxford Commas that it finds. This is useful for those who are not fans of the Oxford Comma and want to remove them from their content. It kills evil Oxford Commas – KEOC!
sections.installation: Getting started with Oxford Comma Go Away is as easy as installing and activating the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

Typically no, but it does parse your entire post content to strip oxford commas so if you have very long content there may be a very small delay. The plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient.
